name: agent-interactive-terminal
description: A real PTY terminal that Kimi Code and the user share, with stable screen snapshots, named keys, a takeover lease, and password prompts that stay with the person.

interface.shortDescription: A real terminal Kimi Code and you can share.
interface.longDescription: Open persistent shell sessions, read stable screen snapshots, wait on output, send named keys, and take over the same PTY in a local browser panel. Passwords and other secrets can be typed by the person without entering the model context.
